manifest_name: YottaFlex OEE Analytics Engine - Source & Attribution Manifest

data_provenance.statement: 100% of telemetry, master data, work orders, state transitions, pulse counts, and quality audits were generated synthetically from first-principles domain mathematical models and PRNG algorithms with fixed seeds. No external, customer, confidential, or proprietary industrial datasets were imported, scraped, or utilized.
